# FitRoom · Virtual Fitting Room

> 779 multi-angle poses (2,912 mannequin references + 1,473 WaveSpeed line art), 2,727 realistic & anime outfits, and 1,499 CC0 AI model portraits. Chinese, English and Japanese UI. Public static files; no authentication. This site supplies reference images, not a hosted image-generation API.

- Site: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/
- Wardrobe & Fitting Room: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/fitting/
- Credits & Attribution: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/CREDITS.md
- Agent skill: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/skills/ai-pose-gallery/SKILL.md
- Optional Python helper: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/skills/ai-pose-gallery/scripts/pose_ref.py
- Pose catalog directory: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/data/catalog.json
- Wardrobe & portrait catalog: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/data/nvzhuang/catalog.json
- Example small category: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/data/catalog/solo/sit.json
- Example original: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/img/solo_sit_lean-bk-kn-up_f.png

Original pose path: img/{type}_{category}_{pose}_{view}.png
Thumbnail path: thumbs/{type}_{category}_{pose}_{view}.jpg
Types: solo, sexy, upper, duo. Views: f (front), d (three-quarter), s (side), hi (high angle), lo (low angle).
Known exact name: fetch directly. Unknown pose: read one category at data/catalog/{type}/{category}.json for canonical pose names and available views. Do not download the full index for a single lookup. Filenames are stable lowercase ASCII, at most 64 characters; display-language changes do not affect URLs.
Originals are 900x1200 PNG drawings, not precomputed OpenPose skeletons. Attach the actual image to the generation tool as a reference; merely placing a URL in the prompt is not a reference-image input.

UI language links: ?lang=zh, ?lang=en, ?lang=ja. Original pose rights belong to ギア; WaveSpeed poses belong to WaveSpeed AI; outfits come from paipiange/nvzhuang (MIT); AI model portraits come from ai-portrait-gallery by あぎ (CC0 1.0). See CREDITS.md for full scope.

## Editable 3D pose references
- Studio: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/studio/
- Character control, scene and PNG API: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/skills/ai-pose-gallery/references/studio.md

The studio supports browser-local photo pose detection and up to six editable figures, adding missing figures automatically. Upload no photo to a remote API. Use poseStudio.poseFromImage(File/Blob), or the renderer helper with --image. Adult MakeHuman/MPFB continuous display mannequins (CC0 meshes) with ivory/white finishes are available; share links contain scene parameters, not photo bytes. Detection is approximate and the sampled gallery line drawings were not reliably detected.

Fixed gallery line art is prepared offline; the browser no longer offers “detect current reference.” Offline 2D inference and original constrained 3D fitting currently produce review drafts, not verified reconstructions. Render existing JSON with render_studio.mjs --scene pose.scene.json --output pose.png --width 900 --height 1200. Compare actual renders to original views before relying on preset names. Human mesh revision makehuman-v3 uses dual-quaternion skinning; contact/collision errors can remain.

WaveSpeed additions: 491 poses / 15 categories / 2946 reference images. Read data/wavespeed/catalog.json, then data/wavespeed/{category}.json. Mannequin: data/wavespeed/img/ws_{category}_{pose}_{view}.webp; line art: data/wavespeed/line/ws_{category}_{pose}_{view}.webp. Views f/d/s. Terms and provenance: data/wavespeed/README.md. These are images only, not editable meshes.
Female figures support bustSize (0–1, default 0.75) and bustSag (0–1, default 0), persisted in scenes and URLs. Cup letters are appearance presets, not bra measurements. Droop is an authored static shape, not dynamic physics.
The studio header link is always available. The Experimental 3D Models switch exposes 231 unapproved offline-converted reference pose groups for preview and appending. Use studio/?experimental=1 for automation. All views share one figure configuration.
